title: GPT-5 nano will be retired on December 11, 2026
body: OpenAI GPT-5 nano will be retired on December 11, 2026. OpenAI GPT-6 Luna is the recommended replacement. API calls to GPT-5 nano are not redirected after that date, so migrate your workloads before December 11, 2026. See [Legacy, deprecated, and retired models](/aws/en/machine-learning/retired-models-policy#retired) for migration guidance.
